title: Best Game Concept Designers (2026): Game Design Documents
description: How to hire a game concept designer for game ideas, mechanics and design documents: scope, originality, how to brief it, price drivers and red flags.
intro: Game concept designers turn ideas into clear game plans: core gameplay loops, mechanics, progression, levels, characters and a game design document (GDD) a team can build from. A good concept is focused, fun to explain and realistic for your budget. Projects go wrong when the concept is too big for the team, mechanics are copied from popular games, or the document is long but vague. This guide helps you get a game concept ready for prototyping.

faq.q: What is a game design document?
faq.a: A document that explains the game's goals, mechanics, controls, progression, content and art direction so the team can build it.

faq.q: Can they design for my platform?
faq.a: Yes. Mobile, PC, console and VR each have different controls and player habits. Tell the designer early.
